speaker: alse_pinder
text: You have been quiet up here, which I distrust until I see your hands. Empty. Good. The cloak is the peg's, and then it is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Empty hands. Three words, and none of them a price. The cloak, and then I am down.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: She is at the street door already, moving the cloth from one arm to the other. That is her way of telling a clock to hurry without owning a clock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the clock can be obeyed. I am not taking the tables into the street. Nine is in my head. It does not need to be in my pocket twice.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your collar. Hold still, or hold still in a moment, when we are on the stair. Gib has not moved. I looked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I believe you. I am not going down to be told the tread and then surprised by the tread.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: If the cloak is on, the door is this way. I am not coming up to fetch a man who can hear a house.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you. The cat is between me and you, and I am coming the long way round him.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The long way is one step to the left. Do not make a procession of it. She will count the steps if you give her time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One step to the left. No procession. Lead, if he is where you said.
